verifier: reopen temporary ZIP, enumerate exact allowlisted members, re-run current DiagnosticSanitizerV1/canary policy over included records and manifest, reject duplicate/path-traversal/unexpected members, then compute final SHA-256 before publication
temporary_policy: write only to a same-directory command-owned temporary ZIP; no temporary path is exposed as a successful bundle and failure removes it best-effort
finalization_policy: only a fully reopened and revalidated temporary ZIP may be atomically renamed to the exact final operator-selected destination, after which the short command-receipt/audit UnitOfWork records immutable export evidence
collision_policy: never overwrite a different existing destination artifact; committed COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 replay may return the recorded artifact only when its digest still matches, otherwise fail closed and require a genuinely new command/destination
contents: bundle-manifest.json with product/version/run correlation and sanitizer-policy version
bounded environment facts from closed allowlist only
excluded: communication bodies/subjects/addresses unless an explicit separately accepted minimized field exists
publication: write temporary ZIP -> reopen -> enumerate exact allowlisted members -> re-run canary scanner -> SHA-256 -> atomic destination publish -> short audit
network: never uploaded automatically; artifact remains operator-managed
